units.source_text: 在棋盘前一落座，名人就显得很高大。

en.t: As soon as he sat down before the go board, the Master seemed imposing and large.

units.source_text: 这当然是全靠他的地位、修养和艺术的力量。

en.t: This, of course, was entirely due to the force of his position, cultivation, and art.

units.source_text: 他身高五尺，上身却很长。

en.t: He was five shaku tall, but his upper body was very long.

units.source_text: 脸盘又长又大，鼻、嘴和耳朵等也都很大。

en.t: His face was both long and large, and his nose, mouth, ears, and the like were all large as well.
In particular, his lower jaw jutted forward.

units.source_text: 在我拍的那张遗容照片上，这些特征也都很显著。

en.t: In the posthumous photograph I took of him, these features were also very pronounced.
